content_patterns: Wizard framing: 'STEP 1 OF 3' uppercase counter, centered instruction heading, and reassuring subtitle. Big-typography numeric input for the core value. Explicit '(OPTIONAL)' annotation on the category section. Per-item destructive affordances (red trash icons). Verb-first CTA 'Continue' with forward arrow. Helper copy explains purpose: 'Allocate your total budget into specific categories like Food, Transport, or Rent.' Reassurance microcopy with info icon: 'You can adjust this later in settings.'
notable_interactions: Blue underline segment implies the amount field is focused/editable (large numeric keypad entry implied). Trash icons imply removing category budgets. 'Add Category Budget' row with chevron implies opening a picker/form to add more. 'Continue' implies advancing to step 2 of the wizard. Back arrow implies exiting onboarding step. State matches an expanded/with-categories variant of budget setup.
